\newlength{\dlboxwidth}
\newlength{\dlboxheight}
\newlength{\dlboxdepth}
\newcommand{\duallayerbox}[2]{%
  \begingroup
  \settowidth{\dlboxwidth}{\strut #1}%
  \settoheight{\dlboxheight}{\strut #1}%
  \settodepth{\dlboxdepth}{\strut #1}%

\section*{Multiple Choice (10 marks)}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item \duallayerbox{Assessing growth in routine practice should be:}{Screening for chronic undernutrition in school health checks should be based mainly on:}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Height only
    \item Weight only
    \item Weight and height
    \item Head circumference
\end{enumerate}
\item The function of the gastrointestinal tract can be classified in several ways. Which of the
following functions is most important for survival immediately after a meal?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Absorption and retention of water and electrolytes
    \item Elimination of toxins
    \item Maintenance of barrier function
    \item Extraction of maximum value from nutrients
\end{enumerate}
\item Which of the following is the yield of ATP from complete oxidation of glucose to carbon
dioxide and water?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item 10
    \item 25
    \item 30
    \item 32
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Which of the following statements is correct?}{Which of the following statements is incorrect?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Cholesterol mainly occurs in the cell walls of bacterial cells
    \item Cholesterol mainly occurs in the cell walls of mammalian cells
    \item Cholesterol mainly occurs in the cell walls of yeast cells
    \item Cholesterol mainly occurs in plant cell walls.
\end{enumerate}
\item Which of the following is a function of \duallayerbox{folate}{pyridoxal phosphate (vitamin B6)}?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Synthesis of TMP (thymidine monophosphate)
    \item Decarboxylation of amino acids to form amine neurotransmitters
    \item Synthesis of methionine from homocysteine
    \item Carboxylation of pyruvate to oxaloacetate
\end{enumerate}
\end{enumerate}

\section*{True / False (10 marks)}
\textit{Answer True or False}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\setcounter{enumi}{5}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{Vitamin C is essential for providing the cofactor necessary for hydroxylation reactions in collagen synthesis.}{Vitamin C plays no significant role in providing the cofactor required for hydroxylation reactions in collagen synthesis.}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{A food additive is safe only if it shows no toxic effects at any dose during its entire period of use.}{A food additive is considered safe if it shows no relevant toxic effects at expected human exposures during its intended period of use.}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{Dietary fat provides energy, forms part of cellular membranes, and plays a role in cell signaling.}{Dietary fat does not provide energy, is absent from cellular membranes, and plays no role in cell signaling.}
\item True or False: The Atherogenic Lipoprotein Phenotype (ALP) is characterized by \duallayerbox{raised levels of HDL and normal triglycerides}{raised levels of small dense LDL and elevated triglycerides}.
\item True or False: In type 2 diabetes, hyperglycemia is primarily caused by increased glucose uptake in the skeletal muscle.
\end{enumerate}

\section*{Long Form Response (20 marks)}
\textit{Answer each question with a clear and complete explanation.}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\setcounter{enumi}{10}
\item Discuss the methods used to evaluate protein quality in human nutrition and explain why
animal growth assays may not accurately reflect dietary protein quality for humans.
\item Discuss the various \duallayerbox{beneficial effects of exercise for individuals with diabetes}{beneficial effects of dietary fiber for individuals with diabetes}, and
critically analyze how exercise can also lead to potential risks such as hypoglycemia.
\end{enumerate}
